<thought>To achieve a one‑step synthesis, the target methyl ester can be formed by a simple esterification of the corresponding carboxylic acid with methanol. Both methanol and the bicyclic carboxylic acid are commercially available and inexpensive, keeping the total cost well below $405. The retrosynthetic tree therefore has a single reaction node (esterification) whose two leaf nodes are the acid and methanol.</thought>
